IntentType.description:
Supported network intent operational categories.

Each category corresponds to a specific type of configuration transformation
tested against the target topology.
IntentType.title: IntentType

description:
Single incremental policy change request presented to the LLM.

Contains the natural language prompt text shown to the model, machine-readable
parameters used by generators/verifiers, and optional ground-truth configuration
patches used by evaluation oracles.

sequence_id.description: Identifier of the sequence this intent belongs to.
sequence_id.title: Sequence Id

type.description: Operational category of the policy change.

params.description: Machine-readable parameters (e.g., IPs, ports, protocols, device targets).
params.title: Params

text.description: Natural-language instruction displayed to the LLM.
text.title: Text

adds_invariant.description: Identifier of the invariant introduced by this intent that must hold henceforth.
adds_invariant.title: Adds Invariant

gold_patch.description: Optional ground truth device configurations; must NEVER be exposed to prompts.
gold_patch.title: Gold Patch

title: Intent
